THEINSATIABLE-SWALLOW.description:
Used to trigger specific card effects.
Swallowing a card counts as [gold]Exhausting[/gold] it.
Swallowing an enemy destroys it.
[b]Feed the Insatiable ![/b]
THEINSATIABLE-SWALLOW.title: Swallow
THEINSATIABLE-SELFSWALLOW.description: If this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold] at the end of this turn, [gold]Swallow[/gold] it.
THEINSATIABLE-SELFSWALLOW.title: Self-Swallow
THEINSATIABLE-DIGEST.title: Digest
THEINSATIABLE-DYNAMIC.description:
Refers to the DynamicVar value in each card's code.
Affects damage, block, energy, draw count, power, and other values.
THEINSATIABLE-DYNAMIC.title: Value
